warrantySupport.introAfter: , as well as the channels available for technical assistance and support. Specific conditions for each piece of equipment take precedence over this general policy when set out in a contract or invoice.

cobertura.title: 1. Warranty Coverage
cobertura.p1: The Injectra warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and components of injection molding machines (hydraulic and electric lines) and industrial robotics solutions, provided the equipment is operated, installed, and maintained according to the technical specifications and manuals supplied by Injectra.

prazo.title: 2. Warranty Period
prazo.p1: The standard warranty period is stated in the sales proposal, sales contract, and technical documentation accompanying each piece of equipment, and may vary by machine line (PRIME, SPEED, VELOCITY, FORM, NEO, ATLAS, HYDRO, TITAN, MAX, EQUORA) and by component (for example, electronic, hydraulic, and peripheral systems).
prazo.p2: The warranty period begins on the date of delivery or start-up of the equipment, as defined in the contract.

exclusoes.title: 3. Warranty Exclusions
list: Normal wear of consumable parts, such as seals, filters, and friction components
Damage caused by improper operation, installation that does not conform to technical specifications, or use beyond the equipment's rated capacity
Technical work performed by third parties not authorized by Injectra
Use of parts or supplies that are not original or approved by Injectra
Damage resulting from inadequate electrical, hydraulic, or infrastructure installation by the customer
Force majeure events, such as power outages, natural disasters, or accidents

comoSolicitar.title: 4. How to Request Warranty Service
comoSolicitar.p1: To request warranty service, the customer must contact Injectra or the authorized representative for their region, providing the equipment's serial number, purchase invoice, and a description of the issue. Our technical team will assess the case and determine the appropriate course of action, which may include remote support, an on-site visit, or shipment of parts.

pecas.title: 5. Replacement Parts and Technical Assistance
pecas.p1Before: Injectra and its representative network provide original replacement parts and specialized technical assistance for the entire line of machinery and robotics, even after the warranty period has ended. Check our

canais.title: 6. Technical Support Channels

canais.p1After: page to open a ticket or speak with our technical team.

contratos.title: 7. Maintenance Contracts and Extended Warranty
contratos.p1: Injectra offers preventive maintenance contracts and extended warranty programs for customers who wish to expand standard coverage or formalize periodic maintenance routines. Commercial terms for these contracts are negotiated individually with our team or authorized representative.

oQueSao.title: 1. What Are Cookies
oQueSao.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your browser or device when you visit a website. They allow the site to recognize your device, remember preferences, and collect information about how the site is used.

comoUsamos.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
list: Ensure the proper functioning of the site and the quote request form
Remember browsing preferences, such as language and region
Understand how visitors use our site and which catalogs and machine lines generate the most interest
Measure the effectiveness of marketing and communication campaigns

essenciais.title: 3.1 Essential cookies
essenciais.p: Necessary for the basic functioning of the site, such as navigating between pages and submitting forms. These cannot be disabled in our systems.

desempenho.title: 3.2 Performance and analytics cookies
desempenho.p: Collect information about how visitors use the site — most-visited pages, browsing time, and traffic source — to help us improve content and usability.

funcionalidade.title: 3.3 Functionality cookies
funcionalidade.p: Allow us to remember choices made by the user, such as language, region, or previously entered form information, for a more personalized experience.

marketing.title: 3.4 Marketing cookies
marketing.p: Used to display more relevant communications and ads based on your interest in our machine lines, robotics, and the Injectra AI platform, both on and off our site.

terceiros.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
terceiros.p1: Some cookies are set by third-party services that appear on our pages, such as traffic analytics tools, maps, and embedded videos. Injectra does not control these cookies, which are subject to the privacy policies of their respective providers.

gerenciar.title: 5. How to Manage Your Cookie Preferences
gerenciar.p1: You can manage or disable cookies directly in your browser settings, blocking new cookies or removing those already stored. Note that disabling essential cookies may affect the proper functioning of the site, including the submission of quote and contact forms.

codigoConduta.p1: Injectra employees, officers, and representatives must uphold principles of integrity, mutual respect, non-discrimination, and workplace safety, avoid conflicts of interest, and always act in compliance with applicable law and the company's internal policies.

anticorrupcao.p1: Injectra does not tolerate any form of corruption, bribery, or improper payment in its business relationships, whether with public or private parties. concorrencia.p1: Injectra competes in the market based on the quality of its products and services, respecting applicable antitrust laws and avoiding agreements or practices that unduly restrict free competition.
